name: MegaZacx
releaseNotes: Fix automatic voice disconnection and keepalive stability: disable Chromium background timer throttling for in-game voice reliability, implement seamless voice auto-rejoin on transient socket reconnection with a 20s grace period, add signaling keep-alive pings to prevent proxy/NAT idle disconnects, allow 8s grace period for WebRTC transient ICE disconnects, and increase server ping timeout to 60s
